title: Column picker lists all 20 columns and never offers the internal cost
preconds: 1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
steps:
1. Open the column picker from its toolbar button.
2. Count the columns listed and check each has a toggle.
3. Look for any on-hand cost / inventory-value entry.
expected:
1. The picker lists all 20 available columns, each with a toggle: Type, Part #, Description, Category, Vendor, Units Sold, Units Returned, Sold (WO), Sold (Parts Sale), Avg Cost, Avg Sell, Revenue, Margin, Margin %, Demand, Last Sale, On Hand, Turns/Yr, Min, Max.
2. No on-hand cost column is offered - the report computes one internally but it is never selectable and never displayed.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 10 (S4-R1, S4-R4, S5-R6), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
